nodes.label: Video Studio Migration Plan
nodes.rationale: Six additive phases (scaffold -> resumable jobs -> engine wrappers -> DubSync Repair -> Library/Exports -> port-5180 cutover), all completed 2026-07-16, plus post-migration Visual Repair, Object Repair, Brand Studio and Clone Winner features; guiding principle: adopt what works, wrap what's risky, rebuild nothing; originals never modified so rollback is always possible.

nodes.label: Adopt-Don't-Rebuild Migration Principle
nodes.rationale: Video Studio = a copy of autoVSL/dashboard rebased into video-studio/, rebound to 5180, with subtitle-studio and dubbing-studio engines wired in as subprocess back-ends; keeps every proven engine in place, changes no source project, and both old apps stay runnable as fallbacks.

nodes.label: DubSync Repair
nodes.rationale: The one net-new feature: fix a bad dub without re-cloning the voice by composing proven functions (re-sync via lipsync.py, re-fit via fit_audio_to_duration, re-normalize, re-mux); reads per-dub provenance to know what to re-run; repairs never touch final.mp4, each lands as a versioned take.
